description: Provider adapter contract (ARCHITECTURE §3.2). Every adapter must pass every check; the TS runner is supabase/functions/_shared/provider/contract.ts (run in CI against the simulated adapter on the local stack, and with GP_LIVE=1 against dev).

checks.rule: capabilities(institution) returns the 5 fields with the right types
every entry has the ProviderEntry required fields (shared/schemas/provider_entry.json), bigint money >= 0, status/creditDebit enums, ISO dates
listEntries returns entries newest first across pages
pages never repeat an entry; the cursor ends (no nextCursor on the last page)
two full listings give the same providerEntryId set and the same content
no entry is booked after now
getBalances returns one bigint balance per account; for wallets it equals the newest entry's balanceAfterMinor
a page never holds more than pageSize entries
